Official snapshot and detailed self-published 2013 appointment biography reviewed, supplemented by legal-profession speech and full-time searches. Search matches for other Mark Dreyfus professionals were excluded.

Representing a government client as a private barrister is not public employment. Volunteer and professional board work are separately excluded. No 20-year exact full-time barrister total is inferred.

Follow-up2026-10-02: added1980–1981 AIAS commissioned research, recovered gerontology project/funding/host affiliations, and independently corroborated2003/04 Bar council, executive and ethics governance.

Searched profession roll/history, historical research publications and institutional histories. No full-time law practice or NLC hours obtained. US energy/education/Avaya namesakes rejected. AustLII2010 profile open returned Internal Error; independent primary material available.

Follow-up2026-10-03: a contemporaneous AIAS project report establishes leave without pay from the NLC for a legal-history research brief expected to start in early November1980 and run six months. AIATSIS finding aids identify related1979 field work and a September1980 Gagudju Association draft. Prospective timing was not converted to exact completed dates or full-time status.

Next leads: NLC1979–81 staff/annual reports and contemporaneous control rules; actual AIAS brief completion/pay/contract and hours; institute1982 appointment/payroll and governing arrangements; exact legal practice/adviser transitions and work pattern. Existing totals remain null.

Fourth follow-up4October2026: Northern Land Council annual-report/staff, Freehills and barrister work-pattern searches returned the official chronology, a1979 field-report archival description and retrospective interview material, but no NLC contract/hours, employer-control evidence, legal-firm full-time statement or exact adviser/practice transitions. The archival 1979 field report is already represented by AIATSIS finding-aid evidence and does not add payroll status. Same-name US legal/medical results and unrelated full-time references were rejected. Early institutional control and private-practice hours remain unresolved; no headline change.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Recovered Melbourne BA/LLB1978 qualification year and September1987 Bar readers cohort from university and court sources, with party offices and adviser portfolios corroborated by official government biography. Course entry is not an employment start. Judicial appointee admission/practice dates and Justice Beach full-time statements rejected as other-person facts. NLC and private-practice searches still lack member-specific hours, leave completion/payroll and dated firm contracts; institute control remains unresolved. Law Council conference fetch Internal Error recovered via independent primary sources. Next actual NLC/AIAS contract, research completion, gerontology appointment and bar-roll/employment boundaries.

Fifth follow-up 5 October 2026: targeted historic NLC, Freehills and gerontology appointment searches across both engines did not recover original personnel/payroll or controlling-arrangement evidence. ALRC-hosted 2013 Access All Ages speech independently repeats the already supported 1982 research fellowship without hours, boundaries or employment entity; current NLC government directory and 2000s annual-report status cannot establish 1979–1981 control. Northern Territory 1979–1980 annual-report search hits included National Library annual reports, not NLC employment evidence, and were rejected. Prospective AIAS six-month schedule remains distinct from actual completion; leave without pay not invented as paid service or precise duration. Other judicial appointees full-time histories and overseas namesakes excluded. Next original early institute/NLC/AIAS employment and historical governance instruments, actual research completion and private-practice work fractions; no totals or status change.

Second targeted primary pass5October2026: re-read original2024 Colin Tatz oration to audit AIAS date precision against contemporaneous prospective schedule. Corrected inherited November1980 start to personally recalled commission year1980; preserved planned early-November/six-month schedule in evidence note without asserting actual attendance.1981 two-paper delivery is preserved as milestone rather than unverified payroll cessation,so actual end_date is now unknown. Exact coextensiveness of commission and legal-history brief remains unresolved; leave without pay cannot be treated as continuing paid NLC years. Original AIATSIS updated finding-aid and NT searches give archival files,not employment/controlling arrangements. No supported fact discarded,rounded month or actual completion invented. Need contract,actual completion/payroll and institute/NLC governance evidence; no numeric headline change.
